profile_text.body:
Pegasystems Inc is a public company headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, traded under the ticker PEGA and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001013857. On its own site the company describes itself as an AI-powered platform for enterprise transformation, saying that organizations use it to automate workflows, personalize customer experiences, and modernize legacy systems. It states that it has served large organizations since 1983.

The company's site presents its AI work around governance and oversight. It describes Pega Platform as unifying AI for mission-critical work, and Pega Blueprint as an AI-powered workspace that brings business and IT together with best practices and governance built in. It says its AI agents operate with context, compliance, and human oversight, and that customers can orchestrate an agentic workforce end to end. These are the company's own characterizations of its products.

The held facts add little beyond corporate identity. The company is a for-profit public company, and its litigation exposure is concentrated in Massachusetts. No lawsuits are listed against it.
